title: Add durable sequential agent workflow walking skeleton
objective: Add the first durable deterministic sequential agent workflow vertical, with Git-backed draft definitions, D1 run state, Cloudflare Workflows execution, exact raw-text handoff, retries and cancellation.
userContext: An authenticated repository maintainer needs to configure two draft agents, arrange them in a deterministic two-step workflow, start a durable run, and inspect the persisted result after closing the browser.
currentBehaviour: The toolkit manages artifacts and diagnostics but has no agent connection registry, workflow definitions, durable run storage, or execution engine.
requiredBehaviour: Provide protected workflow navigation, safe server-side connection discovery, Git-backed agent and workflow definitions, normalized D1 run history, deterministic adapter execution through Cloudflare Workflows, exact persisted raw-text handoff, replay protection, bounded retry and cancellation, and durable run inspection.
userExperience: The maintainer can create two draft agents, order them in a workflow, provide initial text, start a run, and later inspect every persisted attempt and raw handoff. The deterministic test connection is clearly identified as a test facility rather than an AI provider.
functionalRequirements: Add protected Workflows routes and semantic primary navigation.
Keep draft agent and sequential workflow definitions in canonical JSON in the authorised Git repository.
Expose only safe server-side connection descriptors and never browser-side secret entry.
Persist immutable definition snapshots, runs, attempts, inputs, outputs, transitions, timestamps, retries and cancellation in D1.
Execute runs with Cloudflare Workflows using only a run ID as workflow input.
Pass each persisted step output byte-for-byte to the following step.
Use stable per-attempt idempotency keys and reuse persisted provider task IDs on replay.
Provide a deterministic test adapter for immediate, pending, failure, oversized-output and cancellation scenarios.
Enforce documented size, attempt, duration, poll and transition bounds.
Provide protected no-store APIs and accessible durable run history and detail UI.
technicalConsiderations: Git is the source of truth for mutable draft definitions; D1 is the source of truth for immutable operational run state; Cloudflare Workflows provides durable orchestration.
Use a focused storage abstraction with D1 and in-memory implementations.
Keep master prompts and raw input/output out of logs and Workflow step return values.
Do not reuse the artifact catalogue KV binding or change GitHub App permissions.
The deterministic adapter is a test/local smoke facility, not an AI provider.
Keep WF-001 sequential, acyclic and deterministic.
outOfScope: Autonomous routing, agent swarms, parallel branches, loops or conditions.
Handoff schemas, field mapping, scripts, expressions or node graphs.
Team permissions, multi-tenancy, scheduled runs or provider webhooks.
Deployment, merge, CI orchestration, streaming or production definition promotion.
acceptanceCriteria: An authenticated maintainer can create two draft agents and a two-step draft workflow.
A run persists step one output and uses the exact persisted UTF-8 text as step two input.
A completed run remains inspectable independently of the browser session that started it.
Replay does not invoke adapter start more than once per attempt.
Transient retry, terminal failure, manual retry and supported or unsupported cancellation are safely represented.
Credentials never appear in definitions, snapshots, D1 records, APIs, pages, errors or logs.
The deterministic connection is disabled in production unless explicitly enabled and is never described as an AI provider.
Definition, storage, runner, route, rendering and Cloudflare builds are tested.
codexGuidance: Implement WF-001 as a bounded sequential walking skeleton. Preserve all existing authentication, repository, artifact, cache, diagnostics and deployment behavior. The next feature should add the first real provider adapter.
